metadata.case_name: LAI YIP NGAN v. 馬志文 AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: right periorbital bruise with small conjunctival haemorrhage / periorbital swelling over right eye
source: physical examination showed that there was periorbital swelling over the plaintiff’s right eye
the plaintiff suffered right periorbital bruise with tenderness and small conjunctival haemorrhage
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of eyeball or orbital tissues

source: X-ray examination of the plaintiff’s right shoulder, hip, tibia, pelvis and skull showed that there was fracture over right proximal humerus.
X-ray examination of the plaintiff’s right shoulder showed fracture of her right proximal humerus with minimal displacement.
Collar and cuff was given to the plaintiff for immobilization of her fracture right shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of humerus, unspecified site

injuries.description: 3 cm deep laceration over right calf, depth down to muscle layer / full thickness skin laceration on right posterior calf (wound explored and repaired)
injuries.body_part: right posterior calf / right lower leg
source: there was a 3 cm deep laceration over the plaintiff’s right calf, with depth down to muscle layer.
right calf full thickness skin laceration on right posterior calf.
Exploration and repair of right calf wound was performed on 30 March 2014.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: Periorbital swelling over the plaintiff’s right eye
The range of movement of her right shoulder was significantly limited by pain
Feeling weakness, numbness, sense of coldness and discomfort over her right shoulder (worse at nighttime and/or during rainy weather)
Permanent scars on her right lower leg
Mild swelling of the plaintiff’s right lower leg

treatments_received: attendance at Accident and Emergency Department of Caritas Medical Centre
transfer to Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Caritas Medical Centre
exploration and repair of right calf wound (30 March 2014)
collar and cuff immobilisation of right shoulder
physiotherapy (referred; attended two sessions 21 May 2014 to 30 May 2014)

losses.description: Permanent scars on her right lower leg
Significantly limited range of movement of her right shoulder caused by pain and ongoing weakness, numbness and discomfort
